name: Convent de la Missio
positioning: Design hotel in a former 17th-century convent in the historic centre of Palma, with a rooftop pool, a spa and an art-gallery bar
best_for: Travelers who want to explore Palma's historic centre on foot
Guests who enjoy contemporary art and history in one stay

facts.text: The hotel occupies the former Convent de la Missio in the historic centre of Palma.
The building dates from the 17th century and was originally dedicated to training missionaries.
The hotel is within walking distance of numerous restaurants, shops, markets, art galleries and historical monuments.
The rooftop has a solarium with sun loungers, an outdoor swimming pool heated in winter, a chill-out area and a small gym.
The spa area has a sauna, an indoor swimming pool and a relaxation room.
Spa treatments include massages, facials and body exfoliations adapted to the guest's skin type.
The Art Bar is a gallery showing works by local contemporary artists, where guests can have wine or signature cocktails.
Guests can enjoy the Mediterranean cuisine of chef Marc Fosh at the hotel.
Rooms have a king-size bed, free Wi-Fi, television, air conditioning and heating.
Room types are Double Superior, Double Deluxe, Junior Suite, Suite Premium and Luxury Suite.
The convent's old chapel can be booked as a multipurpose room for meetings, conventions or seminars.
The hotel is 12 km from the airport.

highlights.text: A design hotel inside a 17th-century former convent, originally built to train missionaries, in the historic centre of Palma.
The rooftop has a solarium with sun loungers and an outdoor swimming pool heated in winter.
The Art Bar doubles as a gallery of works by local contemporary artists.
The spa area has a sauna, an indoor swimming pool and a relaxation room, with massages and facials.
The convent's old chapel can be booked for meetings and events.

considerations.text: The gym is small and sits on the rooftop.
WhataHotel notes rooms may vary in size due to historic building constraints.
The hotel is in the city centre, 12 km from the airport.
